It features the classic rectangular box camera shape with a black body and a silver metal front plate bearing the Kodak logo and the model's name. The camera has a circular front lens with a viewfinder above, plus the distinctive winding knob on the side. Exact manufacturing year and internal condition are unknown; no accessories or original packaging included. The camera shows minor signs of wear consistent with used vintage condition. A great collectible for vintage camera enthusiasts or Kodak memorabilia collectors. Please see photos for details. Note: This camera is identified by strong visual and textual evidence on the front label and design but authenticity and licensing are not verified.
